properties.description: Built 2026-10-21 (phase 7 PR 1). import_graph keeps whole-node semantics by default; its reply counts, by Type.property, every property removed (`properties_removed`) or changed (`properties_changed`) on a node the design already held, names up to five in `removed_from`, and says what to do in `removed_note`. `merge: true` keeps every stored property a partial node leaves out (as create_nodes does). A value the schema default replaced (artifact_type config→code, an accepted Requirement's status→proposed) is counted as changed, never under `materialized`, which now counts only keys neither the document nor the node held. The served description no longer promises a partial node is refused (only one missing a required property is); the adopt skill sends bulk edits of existing records to create_nodes. The CLI --import prints the removals. Core: export.rs ImportOptions.merge and the report fields; MCP: ImportGraphReq.merge.
properties.name: An import counts what it removed or changed on records that already existed, and merges only when the call asks
